questionText: Why is a high-fiber diet (soluble fiber from oats, legumes, vegetables) recommended for diabetic individuals?

options.text: It causes blood sugar to rise five times faster than pure sugar

options.text: It slows gastric emptying and delays carbohydrate absorption, preventing sharp post-prandial blood glucose spikes
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Role of Fiber in Diabetic Diet.

detailedSolution:

According to NCERT principles for Yoga and Yogic Practices (Role of Fiber in Diabetic Diet):

Hence, Option D is correct.

(A) First bye is given to the last team of the lower half
